name: Employment Visa

requirements.blocker_text: A six-step process: (1) submit passport copy, CV, educational documents, and employment contract, plus a company letter of introduction stating purpose/reason/duration, to Afghanistan's Central Business Registry (ACBR); (2) ACBR issues a bank slip for visa fees after document review; (3) ACBR requests a reference number from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA); (4) MoFA transmits the reference number to the relevant Afghan embassy/consulate; (5) the applicant submits the visa form, photos, original passport, and fees to that embassy once receipt of MoFA's documentation is confirmed; (6) the embassy issues the visa, possibly after a brief interview. The initial visa is single-entry, valid 3 months from issue with a 90-day permitted stay. Foreign workers may later apply for 6-month or 1-year multiple-entry renewals.
requirements.fix_path: Secure an Afghan employment contract and company sponsorship letter, file with ACBR, wait for the MoFA reference number to reach the relevant embassy, then complete the embassy application with fees and photos.

outcome.duration_length: 3 months initially (90-day stay), renewable as 6-month or 1-year multiple-entry

sources.title: Kakar Advocates (Afghan law firm) -- employment visa process via ACBR and MoFA, validity and renewal terms
